description: Return a GTM action plan for one EPIC motion (E Ecosystem and ABM, P Product-Led Growth, I Inbound and Outbound, C Community-Led) over 30, 60 or 90 days: immediate, short-term and medium-term steps, without the self-serve steps when your business model is not a software subscription. Builds text from the inputs only.

business_model.description: Optional. How you charge: software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management. Steps that need a product people can try on their own are left out for a business that is not a software subscription

primary_focus.description: EPIC motion to plan for: E, P, I or C
